what: velotrade_1 skipped a live SOL signal pair on 2026-10-11 (tickets cb656fd5ad42 16:02Z and f7dec8a5bbb4 15:49Z) with reason 'open risk: unrealized_unreported (could not look); risk gate: cushion_unknown (the account-status snapshot is unreadable)'. /api/bot/prop/status?account_id=velotrade_1 reads unrealized=null, realized_today=null, day_pnl_state=unreported on a fresh (0.02 h old) executor snapshot, so the gate treats a fresh snapshot as unreadable whenever the REST executor does not report unrealized PnL. Every velotrade_1 entry while a position is open (or unrealized is null) is refused this way. Question to answer: does the DXtrade/REST adapter have an unrealized field it is not mapping, or should the gate compute unrealized from the open fill + last price? MEASURED from /api/bot/prop/fills and /prop/status 2026-10-12; the refusal is per-trade, not a halt.
